sendCurrentTab: Send only this tab to TabClip
sendTabsExceptThis: Send all tabs except this tab to TabClip
sendAllTabsInCurrentWindow: Send all tabs in current window to TabClip
sendAllTabsInAllWindows: Send all tabs from all windows to TabClip
sendTabsToTheLeft: Send tabs on the left to TabClip
sendTabsToTheRight: Send tabs on the right to TabClip
